description: Validates a Claude Code .mcp.json: transports, commands, URLs, headers and env, and flags literal secrets by path. Returns { ok, servers[{ name, transport }], findings[{ severity: error|warning|info, code, path, message }] and counts { error, warning, info } }. Values are never echoed. Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

config.description: The config as a JSON string (comments and trailing commas allowed) or as an object, up to 60,000 characters.

name: mcp-config-validate
title: MCP config validator
